'''Foam sealant'''' was a tool used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Some [[WED Treadwell repair droid/Legends|WED Treadwell repair droids]] were equipped with foam sealant which they had built into the ends of some of their many [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. A [[Unidentified Imperial Security Bureau WED Treadwell repair droid|WED unit]] which the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] used on [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] was equipped with foam sealant when it attempted to place a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking beacon]] on the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] working for the tech salvaging company [[IsoTech]].<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Foam sealant first appeared in [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''.
